name: Anh Cao
bio: A Representative from Louisiana; born in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; March 13, 1967; graduated from Jersey Village High School; B.S., Baylor University, Waco, Tex., 1990; M.A. Fordham University, Bronx, N.Y., 1995; J.D., Loyola University, New Orleans, La., 2000; teacher; professional advocate; lawyer, private practice; unsuccessful candidate for election to the Louisiana state house of representatives in 2007; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eleventh Congress (January 3, 2009-January 3, 2011); unsuccessful candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Twelfth Congress in 2010; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the United States Senate in 2016.
